segments.subtask: The robot arm approaches the test tubes on the shelf.
The robot arm grasps the test tube with red pigment.
The robot arm lifts the test tube with red pigment and moves it towards the container.
The robot arm pours the red pigment into the container.
The robot arm places the test tube with red pigment back on the shelf.
The robot arm grasps the test tube with blue pigment.
The robot arm lifts the test tube with blue pigment and moves it towards the container.
The robot arm pours the blue pigment into the container.
The robot arm places the test tube with blue pigment back on the shelf.
